title: plantago atrata var. sudetica
intro: Plantago atrata var. sudetica, commonly known as Alpine Plantain, is a plant species belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory and soothing effects. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to reduce swelling and promote wound healing, while its therapeutic actions include astringency and anti-inflammatory activity. The bioactive constituents of Plantago atrata var. sudetica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
